referenceFunction.generalComment: The process “natural gas, burned in industrial furnace 1MWth/MJ/CH,” includes the fuel input from the Swiss natural gas network, the furnace infrastructure, emissions to air and water, and the electricity required for operation. The inventory is based on 1 MJ of natural gas burned in an industrial furnace with a capacity of 1 MW and 5,000 operating hours. UUID: 93e74dc7-ce61-4d0d-a6ac-e46edc0c4488
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset is based on the process “natural gas, burned in industrial furnace 1MWth/MJ/CH.” Compared to this reference process, the dataset does not include air emissions of fossil carbon monoxide, nitrogen oxides, and particulates < 2.5 µm from the combustion of 1 MJ of natural gas, as these emissions are considered separately within the asphalt production processes.

referenceFunction.name: Natural gas, burned in industrial furnace, for asphalt production, 1MWth

technology.text: The process "natural gas, burned in industrial furnace 1MWth/MJ/CH" has been modified to generate a dataset that does not consider air emissions of fossil carbon monoxide, nitrogen oxides, and particulates < 2.5 µm from the combustion of 1 MJ of natural gas in Switzerland.

timePeriod.text: Review of data currency scheduled after 5 years.
